title: tilia caroliniana var. lata
intro: Tilia caroliniana var. lata, commonly known as American linden, is a plant species within the Tilia genus, characterized by its broad, heart-shaped leaves and fragrant flowers. The American linden is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and stress levels, promoting sleep, and acting as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its sedative, spasmolytic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which are thought to be caused by its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils. The bioactive constituents of Tilia caroliniana var. lata have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
